text: make a flyer for our pottery workshop
withheld: One upright digital flyer, four units wide by five units tall, with no particular platform.
The event is at Clay House Studio.
The event date is 24 July 2027 and must appear on the flyer.
The only wording should be Pottery Workshop; 24 July 2027; 14:00–16:00; Clay House Studio; Beginners welcome.
Include a simple drawing of a clay bowl.
The mood should be calm and welcoming.
The fonts and layout are up to you.
The wording should be in English.
